Photo 1 shows the same two cylinders plus coiled orange and blue hoses on the floor, a box labeled "NAKATA Acetylene Regulator", and boxes including one labeled "GAS TORCH".
No brand, model, capacity, or hydrostatic test date is legible on either cylinder in either photo.
Cylinder contents (full or empty) cannot be determined from still photos.
